verdict.rationale: The GitHub repo publishes readable SKILL.md source files for each skill (tdd, triage, grilling, setup) that can be inspected before installing, and docs state installed skills become 'ordinary files you own and can edit' with 'nothing updates behind your back,' supporting post-install review. However there's no explicit CLI command shown for listing skill contents/scripts prior to install, and the alternative 'read-only managed bundle' mode explicitly discourages editing/inspecting individual files as your own. Missing for 10: an explicit pre-install manifest/list command, and evidence of non-markdown scripts being reviewable (only SKILL.md text is shown).
